Canada.label: Canada
Canada.headline: TSX falls ~250 points as financials, metal miners, telecom, utilities and industrials slide amid rising bond yields
Canada.why: Multiple sector declines (financials, metal miners, telecom, utilities, industrials) coincided with a surge in Canadian bond yields that raised expectations of an imminent Bank of Canada rate hike, collectively pulling the index lower.
